style: 信息图风格，扁平化建筑透视，克制精确，暖棕（华尔街）到冷蓝灰（联邦储备）的色彩过渡，体现历史纵深感和制度演化隐喻，无英雄人物、无阴谋论氛围、无戏剧化光影

images.prompt: A cinematic illustration of the interior of J.P. Morgan's private library at 219 Madison Avenue, early 20th century New York. Tall mahogany bookshelves lining the walls, warm amber lamplight, a long conference table at the center. As the viewer's gaze moves toward the deep perspective on the right side, the bookshelves gradually transform into the neoclassical columned facade of the Federal Reserve Board building. The transition is seamless and organic — like something growing from the library itself, not replacing it. The color palette shifts subtly from warm brown tones on the left to cool blue-grey on the right. No people, no text, no dramatic lighting. The architectural forms do the storytelling. Vertical composition optimized for mobile phone screens.

A two-section diagram illustration titled 'From Private Coordination to National Institution' in flat infographic style. LEFT SECTION labeled 'Private Coordination' (small text, top-left corner): A small wood-paneled meeting room with a round table surrounded by 3-5 seated figures in business attire, papers and ledgers spread on the table. The space is enclosed, intimate, warm brown tones. A subtle sense of limited scale. RIGHT SECTION labeled 'National Institution' (small text, top-left corner): A grand marble-columned hall reminiscent of Federal Reserve architecture, open and monumental, cool blue-grey tones. At the center, three converging lines forming a subtle focal point — symbolizing information power, capital power, and organizational authority converging in one coordination hub. Between the two sections, a vertical dotted line divides but does not separate. A flowing arrow-like band connects the left space to the right space, widening as it moves from left to right, representing the amplification of coordination capacity through institutionalization — not replacement, but continuation and expansion. Color palette: warm browns on the left transitioning to cool blue-greys on the right. Flat design, clean lines, no people faces visible, no conspiracy atmosphere, no dramatic shadows. Optimized for vertical mobile phone screen layout.
